name: Sto☆Mani ~Strobe☆Mania~
source:
The heroine sees three mysterious shadows one night, and later joins the newspaper club to investigate the matter and she quickly becomes interested in a student group known as Silver Seek. SS is known across the school as a kind of intriguing, mysterious entity, but the student council is on guard because the group seems to be targeting pieces of art in the school (which for some reason are put on display around the halls). The heroine spends most of the game trying to figure out their identities and motives.

[Edited from [url=http://forum.my-neoromance.com/index.php?/topic/2623-%26-12473%3B%26-12488%3B%26-9734%3B%26-12510%3B%26-12491%3B-%26-65374%3Bstrobe%26-9734%3Bmania%26-65374%3B/page__pid__67774#entry67774]My Neo Romance Forum[/url]]
translation:
某天夜裡，女主角看見了三道神秘黑影。為了調查此事，她隨後加入新聞社，並很快對一個名為「銀色追跡」的學生團體產生興趣。「銀色追跡」簡稱SS，在全校眼中都是神秘又引人好奇的存在；學生會卻始終保持警戒，因為這個團體似乎正把目標對準校園裡的藝術品——不知為何，這些作品都陳列在走廊各處。遊戲大部分時間裡，女主角都在想辦法查明成員的真實身分與行動目的。
